question: A diver rowing at the speed of 3 km/h in still water takes double the time going 50 km upstream compared to going 50 km downstream. The speed of the diver downstream is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Time** (Upstream : Downstream) = 2 : 1

Since **Distance** is constant, the ratio of **Speed** (Upstream : Downstream) = 1 : 2

**Still water speed** of the diver = (Upstream speed + Downstream speed) ÷ 2 = (1 + 2) ÷ 2 = 1.5 units

Given, 1.5 units = 3 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 2 km/h

**Downstream speed** = 2 units = 2 × 2 = 4 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 4 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the **diver** in still water (u) = 3 km/h

Distance covered (d) = 50 km

Let the speed of the **stream** be 'v' km/h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/251d2ca8346ba6a05f0525754c678d6261533046ab4003f7358e7c885482239a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Upstream speed** (vᵤ) = (u − v) = (3 − v) km/h

**Downstream speed** (vd) = (u + v) = (3 + v) km/h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken upstream = 2 × Time taken downstream

⇒ 50 ÷ (3 − v) = 2 × [50 ÷ (3 + v)]

⇒ 1 ÷ (3 − v) = 2 ÷ (3 + v)

⇒ (3 + v) = 2 × (3 − v)

⇒ 3 + v = 6 − 2v

⇒ v + 2v = 6 − 3

⇒ 3v = 3

⇒ v = 1 km/h

⇒ **Downstream speed** = u + v = 3 + 1 = 4 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 4 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed in Still Water

The speed of a boat or person in still water is calculated as u = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Speed of the Current

The speed of the stream or current is calculated as v = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Distance-Speed Relation

When the distance is constant, the time taken is inversely proportional to the speed (Time ∝ 1 ÷ Speed).</p
